user_story: As a Plan Review Staff member, I want to Review Plans, so that I can review them for compliance and either approve, or fail or deny the plans and record any conditions, clearances, or corrections needed from the Applicant.
plantuml:

```plantuml
@startuml
actor PlanReviewStaff
actor System
actor Applicant

PlanReviewStaff -> System: Upload Plans for Review
System -> System: Validate Plan Details
System -> PlanReviewStaff: Acknowledge Receipt of Plans

activate PlanReviewStaff

loop until plans reviewed
    PlanReviewStaff -> System: Review Plans
    System -> System: Evaluate Compliance
    alt Plans compliant
        System -> PlanReviewStaff: Approve Plans
        PlanReviewStaff -> Applicant: Notify Approval

            else
                continue loop
            end
        end
    end
end

deactivate PlanReviewStaff

@enduml
```

This sequence diagram captures the steps involved in plan review, including validation of plan details, evaluation of compliance, and notification of approval or rejection with any necessary conditions, clearances, or corrections.

user_story: As a Plan Review Staff member, I want to Review Plans, so that I can review them for compliance and either approve, or fail or deny the plans and record any conditions, clearances, or corrections needed from the Applicant.
plantuml:
@startuml
actor PlanReviewStaff
actor System
actor Applicant

PlanReviewStaff -> System: Open Plan Review
System -> System: Retrieve Plan & Compliance Checklist
System -> PlanReviewStaff: Display Plan Details for Review

activate PlanReviewStaff

loop For each plan section
    PlanReviewStaff -> System: Evaluate Section for Compliance
    alt Noncompliant
        PlanReviewStaff -> System: Record Corrections Needed
        opt Conditions required
            PlanReviewStaff -> System: Record Conditions
        end
        opt Clearances required
            PlanReviewStaff -> System: Record Required Clearances
        end
    else Compliant
        System -> System: Mark Section Passed
    end
end

alt Approve
    PlanReviewStaff -> System: Approve Plan
    System -> System: Finalize Approval and Record Conditions/Clearances
    System -> Applicant: Send Approval Notification with Conditions/Clearances
    Applicant -> System: Receive Notification
    System -> PlanReviewStaff: Confirm Approval Sent
else Fail (Corrections Required)
    PlanReviewStaff -> System: Fail Plan
    System -> System: Compile Corrections/Conditions/Clearances
    System -> Applicant: Send Correction Notice and Required Items
    Applicant -> System: Submit Corrections
    System -> PlanReviewStaff: Notify Resubmittal
    loop Re-review until compliant
        PlanReviewStaff -> System: Review Resubmitted Items
        alt Corrections acceptable
            System -> System: Update Status/Checklist
        else More corrections needed
            PlanReviewStaff -> System: Add Additional Corrections/Conditions
            System -> Applicant: Request Further Corrections
        end
    end
else Deny
    PlanReviewStaff -> System: Deny Plan
    System -> System: Record Denial Reasons
    System -> Applicant: Send Denial Notice with Reasons
    Applicant -> System: Acknowledge Receipt
    System -> PlanReviewStaff: Confirm Denial Sent
end

deactivate PlanReviewStaff

@enduml

participant "Vision Service" as Vision
participant "Recommendation Service" as Reco
database "Video Catalog" as Catalog

User -> App: Start image-based recommendation
alt Take Picture
  App -> Camera: Open camera
  Camera --> App: Captured image
else Upload Image
  App -> Gallery: Open image picker
  Gallery --> App: Selected image
end
App -> Vision: Analyze image (extract features/tags)
Vision --> App: Features/Tags
App -> Reco: Request recommendations with features/tags
Reco -> Catalog: Query related videos
Catalog --> Reco: Matching videos
Reco --> App: Recommended videos
App --> User: Display recommended videos
@enduml
